projects.title: BRYDE
projects.meta: Client project · Complete system build · Mobile + web
projects.headline: BRYDE — a two-sided rental marketplace for premium vehicles
projects.description: Drivers rent premium cars by the day or month; fleet owners vet drivers, assign vehicles and track what they're owed. I built the whole system: the driver app, the Fleet Owner Portal and the backend that connects them.
highlights: Driver app: browse vehicles, register, rent daily or month-to-month with weekly payments
Fleet Owner Portal: review driver profiles and ratings, approve drivers, assign vehicles
Payment and outstanding-balance tracking so owners can follow collections
One dashboard for vehicles, drivers, rentals and payments

projects.headline: One Biz — the merchant side of a multi-vendor marketplace
projects.description: Sales, bookings and products in one app, with Tabby, Tamara and NearPay payments and offline-first data in Hive.

projects.headline: ONE App — shopping, food, bookings and tickets in one place
projects.description: The customer side of the platform: connects users with local businesses, with several payment methods and real-time order notifications.

accomplishments: Built BRYDE's complete platform end to end: driver app, Fleet Owner Portal and backend for vehicle listings, driver approval, rentals and payment tracking.
Lead the Flutter work on One Biz and ONE App: multi-vendor architecture, Tabby / Tamara / NearPay payments, and offline-first data with Hive.
Built the Ignite business app with MVVM and Provider; integrated SurePay and NearPay terminals and OneSignal push.
Built Doyen, a low-latency live audio app on Agora, plus social sign-in across iOS and Android.
Turned Figma and PSD designs into pixel-accurate, responsive Flutter screens.
